step: S1: Apple TV fills the TV; the original format behind a flag
change: native/Sources/NTSDiOS: NTSDGameView.original (from --original-window or the NTSDOriginalWindow default; -NTSDOriginalWindow YES on a launch line sets it) shows the frame at one point per pixel at the centre (contentsGravity .center, contentsScale 1, reapplied when the view moves to a window or the display scale changes); the game's own full-screen popup (Alt+Enter) still fills the screen in that mode, as the shared backend declares and the macOS host shows it (the present passes the window's popup flag); clientPoint maps through the same scale. The default presentation is unchanged (aspect fit, nearest). Applies to the iPad too.

screenshots.how: the tvOS app (ios_app.py --platform tvos build) launched interactively on the Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) simulators at 1080p (scale 1) and at 4K (scale 2); xcrun simctl io screenshot; the non-black picture's box measured
screenshots.reading: Default: the TV's whole height, 794:550 kept, bars at the sides (1560×1080 px at 1080p, 3118×2160 at 4K) — the launch already filled the TV before this step. Original: 794×550 px at 1080p and 1588×1100 px (794×550 points) at 4K, centred. Original then Alt+Enter (a script holding Alt and pressing Enter at the menu): the popup fills the TV again (1560×1080).

safeArea: Not changed: the picture runs to the top and bottom edges (tvOS's safe area is 60 pt top and bottom, 80 pt at the sides on a 1920×1080 pt screen; the side bars keep the sides inside it, the game's HP bars at the top fall in the top band). Apple's guidelines let full-screen games use the whole screen; a TV that overscans may crop a little at the top and bottom (Apple TV's own overscan setting compensates). Recorded for the user.
scaling: Nearest filtering at a non-integer scale (1.96× at 1080p, 3.93× at 4K) gives uneven pixels (at 1080p 20 rows and 29 columns 1 px narrower); no integer scale fits the height. A smoothed mode is a question for the user.

scenarios.reference: a fresh AppKit run (the frozen app of the tw-w3e gate, run_headless_scenarios.py --local, all 10 scenarios equal) whose 18,030 frame digests are identical, scenario by scenario, to TVOS_WEB T1a's pinned coretext reference (extracted from its T7 archive runs-20261012b.tar)

review: Independent, read-only: OK after one medium fix — in the original format Alt+Enter's full-screen popup would have shown 1:1 instead of filling the screen (fixed: the popup flag reaches the view); low: contentsScale could be reset by UIKit on a display-scale change (fixed: reapplied on window moves and scale trait changes), the safe area and the non-integer nearest scaling (recorded above), backingScale in the 'started' event still 2 in the original mode (left: only reported), the launch-argument wording (fixed), the frame reference (compared against the pinned one).
